capabilities: Insert emojis by typing a trigger character plus keyword
Suggest matching emojis with optional keyword hints
Insert a random emoji via a command
Track and reset most-used emoji statistics
Customize trigger character, language, and keyword mappings
disambiguation: Searches emojis, not note content; it only inserts emoji characters into the editor.
extras: Keyword data covers English, Russian, and Spanish; custom keyword mappings can be reset to defaults.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to search and insert emojis by typing keywords inline while writing.
summary: Emoji autocomplete plugin that inserts emojis by typing a trigger character plus keyword, with Telegram-derived keyword data and usage tracking.
